posts.title: AI Agents Don't Break Your APIs - They Just Stop Compensating for Your Docs
posts.description: Your mature, production APIs aren't actually well-documented. Chances are your human devs have gotten good at compensating for what the docs fail to say. And AI knows it. Net API Notes for 2026/07/30, Issue 261

posts.title: Work Sucks
posts.description: AI is being sold as relief from impossible productivity demands, but in exhausted software organizations it often deepens the problems it claims to solve. Craft to throughput, SaaS to org dependency, and work into value extraction - is this what we want? Net API Notes for 2026/06/05, Issue 260

posts.title: From Shared Knowledge to Private Answers
posts.description: Stack Overflow turned programming into a shared conversation. AI turns it into a private loop. The answers are faster and more tailored—but something essential may be getting lost in the process. Net API Notes for 2026/04/30, Issue 259.
